resources.string: Lets Loqui paste the transcript you just dictated into the text field you have focused. Loqui does not read screen content for any other purpose.
Shows while Loqui is recording your voice.
Keeps the Loqui bubble available over other apps.
Tap the bubble in any app to dictate
Voice input that works in any app. On-device by default, your key if you opt in.
All set: microphone, notifications, bubble and insertion are ready.
Some permissions are still missing. Dictation will fall back to the clipboard.
Free, private, works offline. Model downloads in Phase 2.
Sends audio to the provider you choose, billed to your account.
Add your key to use cloud recognition
Loqui ships with no provider key and no proxy. Cloud mode talks straight from your device to the provider you picked, using your own credentials.
A key is stored for this device.
Stored encrypted with the Android Keystore. Never uploaded anywhere except your provider.
Tidy up transcripts with a language model
Off by default. Raw transcripts are inserted exactly as recognised.
Clean-up runs after recognition and is capped at 1 second. If it is slow, fails or has no key, the raw transcript is inserted.
Local punctuation and capitalisation. No network, no key.
Sends the transcript to the model provider you choose, billed to your account.
Add your key to use cloud clean-up
Cloud clean-up posts the transcript straight from your device to the provider you picked, using your own credentials. Loqui never proxies or pays for these requests.
A key is stored for cloud clean-up.
Enabled: Loqui pastes into the focused field.
Not enabled: Loqui copies the transcript so you can paste it.
The clipboard fallback is always available and needs no permission.
Loqui needs the microphone, notifications and the floating bubble. Accessibility insertion is optional — without it your transcript goes to the clipboard.
All set — the bubble is ready to dictate into any app.
You can finish setup later from the home screen. Until then dictation copies to the clipboard.
Records only while you dictate. Capture runs in a foreground service so you can switch apps mid-sentence.
Required by Android to show the recording and bubble notifications.
Shows the floating bubble on top of the app you are typing in.
Optional. Pastes the transcript into the focused field; without it Loqui copies to the clipboard.
Settings › Accessibility › Loqui text insertion, then switch it on.
Copied to clipboard — paste when ready
No text field focused — transcript copied to clipboard
Cloud mode needs your API key
Android blocked background recording. Open Loqui and dictate from the app.
The provider took too long to respond.
The provider rejected the request. Check your key.
The on-device model is not downloaded yet.
Cloud mode needs your API key. Add it in Loqui settings.
